guard_checks: NETWORK_GUARD and _LAUNCHER literal bytes remain exactly equal to base commit.
Hook binds the exact environment-owned sitecustomize.py path and expected SHA256; no name-based guard-module import.
Private same-dictionary exec globals survive site startup and retain the real audit callback references.
Earlier sitecustomize and matching shadow guard module do not replace the actual guard.
Plain interpreter, plain -> spawn -> plain, and guarded launcher -> spawn -> plain remain guarded.
All socket/DNS negative tests assert activation before probing; AF_UNIX policy remains permitted.
Missing/changed guard exits 78 before user code; optimization cannot remove digest verification.
Runtime admission requires trusted hook bytes and receipt path/hash/startup fields.
CPU check requires guard marker and exact guard RuntimeError; OS PermissionError cannot count as guard proof.

resolved_review_findings.finding: An assert-based new-hook digest gate could disappear under python -O.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Replaced with explicit if/raise; independent optimized tamper probe exits 78 and durable tests cover -O/-OO.

root_cause_coverage: An earlier sys.path sitecustomize reproduces Ubuntu stdlib precedence without editing the system installation. The task-owned .pth exact-path guard executes before that customization.
scope: Read-only production-code review; CPU-only synthetic venv/wheel fixtures and ignored review artifacts. No external provider operations, real dependency reinstall, model import/allocation, GPU call, network request, or OS/security-setting change.
